notes.content:

notes.title: GlintLog #002 - New overgrown biome
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there Glintseekers ⛏️[/h3]

[b]After a month of hard developing, we have some exciting game updates.[/b]

[h3]The updates:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Worked on the second biome, where the overgrowth has take over. You'll encounter new new Enemies and new features in the Mining Mingame there.🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/80920f9a01d3ec80271cdbb4ca6ad9706a64e6aa.gif[/img]

[*] The Ice Hammer has been given new abilities – you can now freeze dirt, rocks and vines, making them easier to break. ❄️

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/f5d28ae44dc80e16124087ec1579c51011470842.gif[/img]


[*] We also composed a new theme for the "Overgrown Biome" - we are curious to see what you think of the new music in our Demo (Coming soon!). 🎵
[/list]

[i]In our GlintLog #003 you can expect even more updates, like new rooms, new animals and new features.
[/i]
Stay tuned!

[h3]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h3]

notes.title: GlintLog #001 - New features for our mining mechanic! ⛏️
notes.content:
[b][h2]Hello fellow Glintseekers ⛏️ [/h2][/b]

[i]*This is the beginning of our new series "[b]GlintLog[/b]" in which we will regularly tell you what we are currently working on.*[/i]

[h3]Todays [b]GlintLog #001 [/b] is about new features in our mining game![/h3]

[b][h3]The updates:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] We implemented an [b]obsidian layer[/b], that is much more durable than other layers. It also features small golden spots that reward you with karat when breaking them. 🟡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/a6fec7990a4f6b3702e2624df688fb8f0fe611a0.gif[/img]

[*] A [b]diamond gemstone[/b] you can insert in your pickaxe to make quicker work of the obsidian layer. 💎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/d60459d35ba77e2a5edc919d4a4a063044372e03.gif[/img]

[*] And a [b]vines layer[/b] for the new overgrown biome (which we are working on) 🌳. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157402/d4fe46d1b72ebcd2933e03137ca49cc69fe79c26.gif[/img]
[/list]

If you have any ideas or feedback, let us know in the comments ❤️
 
[h3]Your Half Soup Team 🍜[/h3]
